key_insight: IGA-ODIL replaces neural-network PINN parameterizations with smooth B-spline/isogeometric bases and a robust residual loss, enabling faster and better-conditioned Gauss-Newton optimization for PDE solving.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical scientific machine learning approach for forward and inverse PDE problems where speed, sparsity, and numerical robustness matter in engineering workflows.
method: Represent the unknown field with B-spline basis functions from isogeometric analysis.
Minimize a robust weighted residual using Gram-operator-based formulations.
Exploit sparse structured Jacobians for efficient Gauss-Newton optimization.
evidence_signal: The method is benchmarked on Poisson, advection-diffusion, Helmholtz, Allen-Cahn, and inverse Helmholtz problems, showing orders-of-magnitude speedups over PINNs and CRVPINNs while keeping high accuracy.
watch_item: Performance depends on spline discretization and problem setup, so implementation complexity and tuning of basis resolution/weights may still affect robustness on new PDEs.
paper_title: IGA-ODIL: Optimizing DIscretre robust Loss with Isogeometric Analysis to solve forward and inverse problems faster using machine learning tools
